utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the repair drive table by the community center at 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Eli — I’ll have the gloves and tools ready at the community center table at 4.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you at 4 at the community center table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit foggy on the details, but I can bring something small that needs fixing on Saturday morning by the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Oren—small stuff is perfect. Just bring it by Saturday morning at the front porch, and we’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll do that. Thanks, Jules—I'll bring something small that needs fixing Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need the pickup time and the first items before I can plan my route properly—do we know what they need most at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds right—I’d like to confirm the pickup time first, then I can figure out the best route. Once we know the top items, I can help keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, let’s confirm the pickup time first—do we know when they want us there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re meeting this Saturday morning by the community hall to collect broken items for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything small that needs fixing, just bring it along and I’ll help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s helpful—thank you. I’ll see if I have anything small that needs fixing and bring it by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just point me to what’s needed and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know who needs help getting things fixed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know what needs fixing and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of what we still need for the repair drive—just let me know what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be a huge help, Cleo—send me the latest list and I’ll get it out to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—I’m ready to tally up what’s been gathered and what’s still needed. Just send me the latest items, and I’ll help keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, please bring it by later today—I can take the lamp. Just so everyone knows, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll bring the wrench set and drop off the lamp later today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Dane — that’s a huge help. I’ll keep the list updated and see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — Saturday morning at the community hall. If you could have the drill and tools sorted by then, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep mentioning it and I’ll make sure the drill and tools are sorted by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Vik — that really helps. See you Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Uli, is the repair drive still happening on Sunday at the community center? I’m bringing the lamp by later.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for bringing the lamp; I’ll be there to help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Uli — I’ll bring the lamp by on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s happening this Saturday morning by the community hall. If you have any broken items, bring them along and I’ll help sort them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. Do you still need any tools or supplies for the repair drive? I can help look around.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m still short on a few basics like screwdrivers, tape, and small containers for parts. If you spot any, please bring them by the community hall Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, 4:30 works for me—I can come by after school pickup and stay a bit before dinner.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—see you at 4:30. I’ll have the gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then—thanks for having the gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is really happening, right? And Hana’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening — but it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. And yes, Hana’s organizing it, so I’ll keep an eye out for any screwdrivers or extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—so it’s Sunday at the community center now, and Hana’s still organizing it, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — just let me know what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll help keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I can bring a few spare tools and help sort what’s still needed. What’s the latest list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got spare tools and help sorting on the list. If you can also check whether we still need nails, tape, or extension cords, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an ear out for neighbors who need a hand with repairs while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Just let me know the time and I’ll be there with the small repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll pass along the time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s this Saturday morning by the community hall—bring any small broken items you want fixed, and I’ll help sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can swing by after school pickup on Saturday morning, but I’ll need to head out before dinner.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that should still give you time to drop things off and get them sorted. I’ll be there at the community hall Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s Sunday now at the community center — I’ll be there with the repair drive table. If you need anything, just let me know and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — I’ll bring the lamp by on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll watch for your lamp on Sunday at the community center. If you need a hand carrying it in, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What do you need a hand with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—could you send me the list of needed repairs and I’ll get it out to everyone right away?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll send over the list right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, I’m a bit late—just checking in on the repair drive. Since it’s at the community center Sunday, I’ll bring the wrench set when I head over later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Dane — I’m a little foggy, but that sounds helpful. I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch, and I could still use an extra hand if you’re around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Oren — I think the drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll meet you there instead. I’ll bring the wrench set and help out then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I think it’s still happening, but I haven’t caught the newest details yet. If you want, I can check on who’s organizing it and send them along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still a bit out of the loop, so any update would help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive—just point me to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right? And who should I check with about what’s been gathered so far?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, it’s still happening. Check with Cleo about what’s been gathered so far, and I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—before I help, can you tell me what kind of repair drive it is and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s a neighborhood repair drive at the community hall on Saturday morning, where folks bring small things that need fixing. We’re sorting requests like lamps, drills, and other tools, and then prioritizing what to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. Do we know the pickup time and which items need to be tackled first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, the repair drive is definitely on, and I’m helping organize it. Thanks — if you can spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word. We’re meeting this Saturday morning by the community hall, and I’ll help sort any small broken items that people bring along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Mara—thanks for helping sort things out. Saturday morning by the community hall sounds great; I’ll make sure people know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’m organizing it this Saturday at the front porch. If you can help sort things for a bit, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help sort, but I’ll need the pickup time and the first few items first so I can plan my route properly. Do you know what they need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly small broken things like lamps, toasters, and wobbly chairs. I’ll be at the front porch Saturday morning, and any extra hands for sorting would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — please tell them it’s Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll send the list of repairs to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll pass along your repair list when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Vik — I’ll send over the repair list as soon as it’s ready.
